summary: Navitas Semiconductor filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to sell up to $125M of Class A common stock at-the-market via Craig-Hallum and UBS. The offering is under Rule 415(a)(4) with no specific number of shares required; sales are at prevailing market prices ($18.20 as of May 8). Agents receive up to 3% commission. No escrow, no fixed terms, and proceeds for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM program, not a special situation.
